description: This Java class 'ProxyActor' extends 'AbstractThingProxyActor' and acts as an Akka actor delegating command messages to appropriate receivers in a distributed system. It provides methods to create actor properties with specific actors for message handling.

classes.name: ProxyActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class responsible for delegating Commands within a distributed cluster setup.

methods.description: Private constructor initializing the actor with references to mediator and other actors.
